validate_metadata_default.description: Allows to select the level of validation after metadata transformation.

profile_dir_default.description: Directory where LVM looks for configuration profiles.

dir_default.description: Directory in which to create volume group device nodes.

scan_default.description: Directories containing device nodes to use with LVM.

hints_default.description: Use a local file to remember which devices have PVs on them.

use_devicesfile_default.description: Enable or disable the use of a devices file.

devicesfile_default.description: The name of the system devices file.

devicesfile_backup_limit_default.description: The max number of backup files to keep in /etc/lvm/devices/backup.

search_for_devnames_default.description: Look outside of the devices file for missing devname entries.

device_ids_refresh_default.description: Find PVs on new devices and update the device IDs in the devices file.

filter_default.description: Limit the block devices that are used by LVM commands.

global_filter_default.description: Limit the block devices that are used by LVM system components.

sysfs_scan_default.description: Restrict device scanning to block devices appearing in sysfs.

scan_lvs_default.description: Allow LVM LVs to be used as PVs.

multipath_component_detection_default.description: Ignore devices that are components of DM multipath devices.

multipath_wwids_file_default.description: The path to the multipath wwids file.

md_component_detection_default.description: Enable detection and exclusion of MD component devices.

md_component_checks_default.description: The checks LVM should use to detect MD component devices.

fw_raid_component_detection_default.description: Ignore devices that are components of firmware RAID devices.

md_chunk_alignment_default.description: Align the start of a PV data area with md device's stripe-width.

default_data_alignment_default.description: Align the start of a PV data area with this number of MiB.

data_alignment_detection_default.description: Align the start of a PV data area with sysfs io properties.

data_alignment_default.description: Align the start of a PV data area with this number of KiB.

data_alignment_offset_detection_default.description: Shift the start of an aligned PV data area based on sysfs information.

ignore_suspended_devices_default.description: Ignore DM devices that have I/O suspended while scanning devices.

ignore_lvm_mirrors_default.description: Do not scan 'mirror' LVs to avoid possible deadlocks.

require_restorefile_with_uuid_default.description: Allow use of pvcreate --uuid without requiring --restorefile.

pv_min_size_default.description: Minimum size in KiB of block devices which can be used as PVs.

issue_discards_default.description: Issue discards to PVs that are no longer used by an LV.

allow_changes_with_duplicate_pvs_default.description: Allow VG modification while a PV appears on multiple devices.

allow_mixed_block_sizes_default.description: Allow PVs in the same VG with different logical block sizes.

use_blkid_wiping_default.description: Use blkid to detect and erase existing signatures on new PVs and LVs.

wipe_signatures_when_zeroing_new_lvs_def.description: Look for and erase any signatures while zeroing a new LV.

mirror_logs_require_separate_pvs_default.description: Mirror logs and images will always use different PVs.

raid_stripe_all_devices_default.description: Stripe across all PVs when RAID stripes are not specified.

cache_pool_metadata_require_separate_pvs.description: Cache pool metadata and data will always use different PVs.

cache_metadata_format_default.description: Sets default metadata format for new cache.

cache_mode_default.description: The default cache mode used for new cache.

thin_pool_metadata_require_separate_pvs_.description: Thin pool metadata and data will always use different PVs.

thin_pool_crop_metadata_default.description: Older version of lvm2 cropped pool's metadata size to 15.81 GiB.

thin_pool_zero_default.description: Thin pool data chunks are zeroed before they are first used.

thin_pool_discards_default.description: The discards behaviour of thin pool volumes.

thin_pool_chunk_size_policy_default.description: The chunk size calculation policy for thin pool volumes.

zero_metadata_default.description: Zero whole metadata area before use with thin or cache pool.

physical_extent_size_default.description: Default physical extent size in KiB to use for new VGs.

vdo_use_compression_default.description: Enables or disables compression when creating a VDO volume.

vdo_use_deduplication_default.description: Enables or disables deduplication when creating a VDO volume.

vdo_minimum_io_size_default.description: The minimum IO size for VDO volume to accept, in bytes.

vdo_block_map_cache_size_mb_default.description: Specifies the amount of memory in MiB allocated for caching block map pages for VDO volume.

vdo_block_map_period_default.description: The speed with which the block map cache writes out modified block map pages.

vdo_use_sparse_index_default.description: Enables sparse indexing for VDO volume.

vdo_index_memory_size_mb_default.description: Specifies the amount of index memory in MiB for VDO volume.

vdo_slab_size_mb_default.description: Specifies the size in MiB of the increment by which a VDO is grown.

vdo_ack_threads_default.description: Specifies the number of threads to use for acknowledging completion of requested VDO I/O operations.

vdo_bio_threads_default.description: Specifies the number of threads to use for submitting I/O operations to the storage device of VDO volume.

vdo_bio_rotation_default.description: Specifies the number of I/O operations to enqueue for each bio-submission thread before directing work to the next.

vdo_cpu_threads_default.description: Specifies the number of threads to use for CPU-intensive work such as hashing or compression for VDO volume.

vdo_hash_zone_threads_default.description: Specifies the number of threads across which to subdivide parts of the VDO processing based on the hash value computed from the block data.

vdo_logical_threads_default.description: Specifies the number of threads across which to subdivide parts of the VDO processing based on the hash value computed from the block data.

vdo_physical_threads_default.description: Specifies the number of threads across which to subdivide parts of the VDO processing based on physical block addresses.

vdo_max_discard_default.description: Specified the maximum size of discard bio accepted, in 4096 byte blocks.

vdo_pool_header_size_default.description: Specified the empty header size in KiB at the front and end of vdo pool device.

report_command_log_default.description: Enable or disable LVM log reporting.

command_log_sort_default.description: List of columns to sort by when reporting command log.

command_log_cols_default.description: List of columns to report when reporting command log.

command_log_selection_default.description: Selection criteria used when reporting command log.

verbose_default.description: Controls the messages sent to stdout or stderr.

silent_default.description: Suppress all non-essential messages from stdout.

journal_default.description: Record lvm information in the systemd journal.

overwrite_default.description: Overwrite the log file each time the program is run.

level_default.description: The level of log messages that are sent to the log file or syslog.

indent_default.description: Indent messages according to their severity.

command_names_default.description: Display the command name on each line of output.

prefix_default.description: A prefix to use before the log message text.

debug_file_fields_default.description: The fields included in debug output written to log file.

debug_output_fields_default.description: The fields included in debug output written to stderr.

backup_default.description: Maintain a backup of the current metadata configuration.

backup_dir_default.description: Location of the metadata backup files.

archive_default.description: Maintain an archive of old metadata configurations.

archive_dir_default.description: Location of the metadata archive files.

retain_min_default.description: Minimum number of archives to keep.

retain_days_default.description: Minimum number of days to keep archive files.

history_size_default.description: Number of lines of history to store in ~/.lvm_history.

umask_default.description: The file creation mask for any files and directories created.

test_default.description: No on-disk metadata changes will be made in test mode.

si_unit_consistency_default.description: Distinguish between powers of 1024 and 1000 bytes.

activation_global_default.description: Enable/disable communication with the kernel device-mapper.

wait_for_locks_default.description: When disabled, fail if a lock request would block.

locking_dir_default.description: Directory to use for LVM command file locks.

prioritise_write_locks_default.description: Allow quicker VG write access during high volume read access.

abort_on_internal_errors_default.description: Abort a command that encounters an internal error.

metadata_read_only_default.description: No operations that change on-disk metadata are permitted.

mirror_segtype_default_default.description: The segment type used by the short mirroring option -m.

support_mirrored_mirror_log_default.description: Enable mirrored 'mirror' log type for testing.

raid10_segtype_default_default.description: The segment type used by the -i -m combination.

sparse_segtype_default_default.description: The segment type used by the -V -L combination.

lvdisplay_shows_full_device_path_default.description: Enable this to reinstate the previous lvdisplay name format.

use_aio_default.description: Use async I/O when reading and writing devices.

use_lvmlockd_default.description: Use lvmlockd for locking among hosts using LVM on shared storage.

lvmlockd_lock_retries_default.description: Retry lvmlockd lock requests this many times.

sanlock_lv_extend_default.description: Size in MiB to extend the internal LV holding sanlock locks.

sanlock_align_size_default.description: The sanlock lease size in MiB to use on disks with a 4K sector size.

lvmlockctl_kill_command_default.description: The command that lvmlockctl --kill should use to force LVs offline.

thin_check_executable_default.description: The full path to the thin_check command.

thin_restore_executable_default.description: The full path to the thin_restore command.

thin_check_options_default.description: List of options passed to the thin_check command.

thin_repair_options_default.description: List of options passed to the thin_repair command.

thin_restore_options_default.description: List of options passed to the thin_restore command.

command_names_global_default.description: Display the command name on each line of output.

prefix_global_default.description: A prefix to use before the log message text.
